name: ChatGPT Ads Browser Plugins
description: Captures the OpenAI browser reference (obref) and oppref click ID in the browser and adds them to events for ChatGPT Ads.

chatgptAdsPlugin.title: ChatGPT Ads Browser Plugin
chatgptAdsPlugin.description: Enriches Segment payloads with the ChatGPT Ads oppref querystring value and the __obref cookie value, so the ChatGPT Ads Conversions destination can send them. Segment does not check consent: you are responsible for loading this destination only when your measurement consent requirements allow reading the __obref cookie.
chatgptAdsPlugin.defaultSubscription: type = "track" or type = "identify" or type = "page" or type = "group" or type = "alias"
